Info

Defines outbound provides dataclass for the kinematics subsystem.

class scaralang.core.service.kinematics.provides.KinematicsProvides(*, envelope: IWorkspaceEnvelope, planar: IPlanarKinematicsSolver, spatial: ISpatialKinematicsSolver, workspace: IWorkspaceBoundsEvaluator, jacobian: IJacobianCalculator, numerical_planar: INumericalPlanarKinematicsSolver, numerical_spatial: INumericalSpatialKinematicsSolver)[source]¶

Bases: object

Outbound provides dataclass for the kinematics subsystem.

It defines:

attributes:
envelope - Injected IWorkspaceEnvelope protocol instance.
planar - Injected analytical IPlanarKinematicsSolver protocol instance.
spatial - Injected analytical ISpatialKinematicsSolver protocol instance.
workspace - Injected IWorkspaceBoundsEvaluator protocol instance.
jacobian - Injected IJacobianCalculator protocol instance.
numerical_planar - Injected INumericalPlanarKinematicsSolver instance.
numerical_spatial - Injected INumericalSpatialKinematicsSolver instance.
